fact: The African Union's status list of 2 February 2026 records that Tunisia signed the Malabo Convention on 2019-04-23 and had not ratified it.

Organic law no. 2004-63 of 27 July 2004 on the protection of personal data was promulgated, setting the general processing, consent and rights regime; the document's capture note of 3 September 2026 calls it the operative statute with no replacement adopted.
